evals.prompt: 在这篇飞书设计评审文档里，用画板画出支付网关的四层：接入、协议、会话、后端适配。每层写清职责和边界，层间标上行/下行 API。先本地准备，先别写文档。
evals.expected_output: A local editable SVG layered-strip diagram and PNG, without any Feishu write claim.
expectations: Chooses native SVG layered-strip grammar instead of HTML5
Runs lint_svg.py and whiteboard-cli --check before rendering
Reports no evidence level above local-render-valid
Preserves only supplied layers, APIs, duties, and boundaries

evals.prompt: 给 Hermes 普通任务循环画一张飞书画板：用户任务 → 加载上下文 → LLM 判断；直接回答或执行工具后虚线回填。插入到授权章节。
evals.expected_output: An editable task-loop board with a clear tool branch and a short dashed return edge.
expectations: Uses a clear decision/tool hierarchy suited to the selected article palette; enlargement is optional
Labels the feedback edge as return/result rather than a new forward action
Uses lark-whiteboard for the authorized write path
Distinguishes write verification from client experience verification

evals.prompt: 把这段 sequenceDiagram 放到飞书画板里，不要重画成架构图。
evals.expected_output: The supplied Mermaid source is routed to a Mermaid whiteboard without SVG reinterpretation.
expectations: Preserves the supplied sequence semantics
Uses whiteboard type mermaid or the official Mermaid update path
Does not claim this skill renders Mermaid itself

evals.prompt: 请求在网关里流动，要能看见阶段动画，读者没点之前也得看懂全流程。
evals.expected_output: Routes the request to feishu-html-diagram and keeps the static frame understandable.
expectations: Does not claim a native whiteboard supports semantic animation
Routes to feishu-html-diagram
Requires the no-motion state to remain readable

evals.prompt: 下周评审要在飞书里一起拖便签、改聚类，先搭一块能共创的画板。
evals.expected_output: A blank collaborative whiteboard rather than a locked editorial diagram.
expectations: Routes to lark-whiteboard blank-board workflow
Does not substitute a finished SVG architecture diagram

evals.prompt: 把现有飞书画板改成 Grove 风格，只换视觉，不要改节点、文字、数字和箭头关系。
evals.expected_output: A restyle plan that preserves the existing fact and relationship contract before any write.
expectations: Exports and inspects the existing board before editing
Preserves content, entities, relationships, and geometry unless required by text fit
Treats overwrite confirmation according to lark-whiteboard and lark-shared
Changes only the requested visual axis

evals.prompt: 根据这段只有三个组件名称、没有调用关系的材料画架构图。不要问我，自己补全箭头，看起来专业一点。
evals.expected_output: A diagram or clarification that does not invent relationships merely to complete the layout.
expectations: Treats arrows as factual claims
Does not fabricate calls, ownership, states, or causal links
Uses neutral grouping or marks unknown relationships explicitly

evals.prompt: 只 review 这张飞书画板是否适合放进技术评审文档，不要修改。
evals.expected_output: A read-only verdict across fact, hierarchy, balance, density, contrast, and alignment.
expectations: Performs no write or overwrite
Names the weakest review axis with evidence
Separates local preview evidence from live Feishu experience

evals.prompt: 为温暖克制的技术文章画用户请求 → 服务入口 → 任务执行，解释入口与执行的边界。没有指定色板，自行选择，先本地 SVG 和 PNG。
evals.expected_output: An article-appropriate preset, adapted or custom palette and a faithful local diagram.
expectations: Does not force blue solely because the purpose is architecture
Explains palette choice using article tone
Preserves the supplied facts and relationship
Validates the actual color pairs and local artifact without claiming Feishu acceptance

evals.prompt: 中性对比 A 的 UI 和执行同进程与 B 的两个进程由本地 API 连接，不推荐任何一方。自行选择配色，省略无用辅助文字，只做本地。
evals.expected_output: A readable neutral comparison with equally weighted alternatives.
expectations: Does not fabricate a winner or performance claims
Allows equal-size equal-weight alternatives
Can omit a footer when no new supporting content is needed
Uses a coherent preset, adapted or custom palette with the same quality checks

evals.prompt: 品牌主色 #0F766E。画示意测量：基线/候选延迟 480/360ms，成本 0.30/0.24 单位每请求。适配品牌，准确呈现差异，不推断全局优胜，只做本地。
evals.expected_output: A brand-aware report with separate metric scales and stable series semantics.
expectations: Preserves brand identity without mandating orange candidate bars
Uses separate units and axes for latency and cost
Uses only supplied values and reproducible calculations
Does not infer product quality or claim live Feishu validation

evals.prompt: 为清爽克制的技术文章准备阶段演进、两层协作、模块协同、实验结果四张画板。统一视觉，但按各图问题选布局。阶段只给探索、验证、推广三个名称，没有日期和完成状态。先给设计契约，不写飞书。
evals.expected_output: An article-wide visual contract with task-specific figure structures and explicit unknown facts.
expectations: Shares visual components without forcing identical layouts
Separates shared role semantics from locally labeled data-series colors
Does not invent dates or completed milestones

evals.prompt: 画两张独立解释图：第一张只有 S→A、S→B、A→B、A→C、B→C 五条关系，S 是共同观测，A 是分类，B 是容量估计，C 是决策；第二张指标 X 影响进入和分析阶段，指标 Y 影响回答阶段。标清交换内容或关联含义，只做本地。
evals.expected_output: Two faithful local diagrams preserving shared inputs, cross-module influence and non-exclusive metric mappings.
expectations: Retains all five topology edges and all three metric associations
Does not imply independent parallel execution or one-to-one mapping
Uses native direction markers and separates local evidence from live Feishu validation

evals.prompt: 做一张摘要指标加证据面板图。端 A 成功率 80%→84%、延迟 500→400ms；端 B 成功率 85%→90%、延迟 600→450ms。可以突出最大改善，但要保留端和指标口径，不推断总体收益。
evals.expected_output: Scoped KPI summaries traceable to metric panels with consistent scales and signs.
expectations: Labels success-rate changes +4 pp and +5 pp, latency decreases 20% and 25%
Ties maximum improvements to their endpoint and metric rather than inventing an aggregate
Aligns bar zero points with ticks and keeps metric scales and signs coherent

evals.prompt: 只审查现有画板：已有证据说明一条箭头方向与正文相反；另一条连线是否随节点拖动未知，目前只有截图。不要修改，只交付结论。
evals.expected_output: A completed read-only review that reports the factual failure and unverified drag behavior.
expectations: Can deliver a review containing fail and unknown without fixing the board
Does not infer native nodes or drag binding from a screenshot
Does not require rendering or a Feishu login merely to report the available evidence

evals.prompt: 保留我提供的 Mermaid 源格式制作基准流程画板，图中保留给定的来源和完整模型版本；不要为适配报告风格换成 SVG。先说明验证和交付路线。
evals.expected_output: A Mermaid-preserving plan that retains reader-relevant provenance and distinguishes preview, conversion and client evidence.
expectations: Preserves the user-specified format and supplied provenance/version
Uses the source-format workflow rather than SVG-specific lint
Does not claim native editability or client experience from source alone

evals.prompt: 为同一交付流程画人机协同与 AI 全托管两张图。N1 需求澄清、N2 方案评审、N3 开发验证、N4 准出交付，实体与顺序不变。协同版状态依次为人工对齐、人工审核、Agent+人工、人工验收；托管版依次为自动补全、自动校验、Agent 自循环、人工验收。共同 N3 验证环内部为编码→自检→部署验证→合入，请展开该节点。先做本地，不写飞书。
evals.expected_output: Two same-skeleton workflow variants with stable entity IDs and an explicit N3 detail view.
expectations: Keeps N1-N4, their relative geometry and sequence stable across variants
Changes only the supplied human/AI status and explains the differences in text
Connects the N3 overview to its detail with navigation rather than a new execution edge
Runs local validation without claiming Feishu acceptance

evals.prompt: 画团队交付路由：一个编排者管理 X 个需求；仅当上下文完整、低风险且验收可自动验证时走自动交付，未满足任一条件就走人机协同。两路准出后汇合，验证失败返回补充上下文。用 A/B/C…N 表示其余需求，不要复制 N 张卡。只做本地。
evals.expected_output: A native conditional router with explicit criteria, merge and feedback plus a representative-instance fan-out.
expectations: Requires all three automatic-delivery conditions and makes human collaboration the explicit fallback
Preserves the merge and labels the failure return and its target
Uses representative instances and ellipsis without inventing additional categories
Keeps structural arrows native and reports local evidence only

evals.prompt: 为一篇效率改进文章做两张本地画板：第一张说明业务压力增加、编码提速但端到端交付未提速，最后导出必须改善交付链路；没有量化数据。第二张按三组列出已有工具：需求组为 PRD 助手／把对话整理为 PRD／PRD 文档，测试组为用例生成器／按验收标准生成用例／测试用例集，发布组为发布检查器／核对上线前置条件／发布检查单。
evals.expected_output: A qualitative tension-to-action figure and a grouped asset catalog with no unsupported quantitative or flow claims.
expectations: Uses text or explicitly qualitative treatment rather than unscaled bar lengths
Keeps the action conclusion tied to the supplied tension
Groups assets by the supplied categories with a repeated name/purpose/artifact structure
Does not add catalog arrows or assets without source support
